Meditation Centre Performance Society
(Incorporation)
AN ACT TO INCORPORATE THE SRI NATHA AHASTHANA INTERNATIONAL
BUDDHIST MEDITATION CENTRE PERFORMANCE SOCIETY
WHEREAS a Society called and known as the “Sri Natha
Ahasthana  International  Buddhist  Meditation  Centre
Performance  Society”  has  heretofore  been  formed  in  Sri
Lanka for the purpose of effectually carrying out its objects
and transacting all matters connected with the said Society
according to the rules agreed to by its members:
AND WHEREAS the said Soiety has heretofore successfully
carried out and transacted the several objects and matters for
which it was established, and has applied to be incorporated
and it will be expendient to grant the said application:
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Sri  Natha  Ahasthana
International  Buddhist  Meditation  Centre  Performance
Society  (Incorporation) Act, No.     of 2017.

2.
(1) From and after the date of commencement of this
Act, such and so many persons as now are members of the Sri
Natha Ahasthana International Buddhist Meditation Centre
Performance Society (hereinafter referred to as the “Society”)
or  shall hereafter be admitted as members of the Corporation
hereby constituted, shall be a body corporate with perpetual
succession,  under  the  name  and  style  of  the  “Sri  Natha
Ahasthana  International  Buddhist  Meditation  Centre
Performance  Society”  (hereinafter  referred  to  as  the
“Corporation”), and by that name may sue and be sued, with
full power and authority to have and use a common seal and
to alter the same at its pleasure.
